# WalkInTubWithShower.com

> Plain-English guides and free tools about one product question: the walk-in tub with a shower (walk-in tub shower combo). Covers who it suits, how a household with a soaker and a stand-up showerer shares one unit, hand-held vs fixed shower heads, curtains and glass on a walk-in tub, the drain wait, water heater sizing, fit in a 60-inch alcove, safety, and how a combo compares with a walk-in or roll-in shower. Run by Aging Safely Baths, a BBB-accredited walk-in tub and accessible shower company. Phone: 1-888-779-2284. Email: sales@agingsafelybaths.com.

Facts used on this site come from published manufacturer spec sheets (Ella's Bubbles, Hydro Dimensions) and public sources (CDC, NIA, CPSC, ENERGY STAR, U.S. DOE, EPA WaterSense, ICC, ADA Standards). The site does not publish prices; quotes are written and free.

Aging Safely Baths sells and installs walk-in tubs from Hydro Dimensions, Ella's Bubbles (authorized dealer), Bestbath including RANE by Bestbath, and Meditub. Installation is available in many areas; supply-only delivery is offered across the U.S. and to Canada.

## Tools
- [Decision helper: combo, walk-in tub or walk-in shower?](https://walkintubwithshower.com/combo-or-shower-quiz/): eight questions about who bathes and how; suggests a combo, soak-only walk-in tub, walk-in shower or roll-in shower, with reasons.
- [60-inch alcove fit checker](https://walkintubwithshower.com/alcove-fit-checker/): checks alcove length and depth, drain end, delivery doorway, clear floor and shower walls against a tub size.
- [Water heater sizing for a walk-in tub with shower](https://walkintubwithshower.com/water-heater-sizing/): hot water for one bath plus the household's showers in the same hour, against a tank's first-hour rating or a tankless unit's flow; table of published occupied capacities (30 to 90 gallons).

## Guides
- [Who a walk-in tub shower combo is for](https://walkintubwithshower.com/who-needs-a-tub-shower-combo/): households where one person bathes seated and another showers standing, and when a combo is the wrong choice.
- [Handheld vs fixed shower head on a walk-in tub](https://walkintubwithshower.com/handheld-vs-fixed-shower-head/): seated vs standing use, hose length (59 in. minimum in the ADA standards), slide bars, diverters and anti-scald valves.
- [Curtain, glass screen and splash control](https://walkintubwithshower.com/curtain-glass-and-splash-control/): keeping spray off the door seal, waterproof walls, curtain vs glass.
- [Drain time and the wet-seat wait](https://walkintubwithshower.com/drain-time-and-the-wet-seat-wait/): why the door stays shut until the tub drains, what sets drain time, and a routine using the hand shower to stay warm.
- [Plumbing checklist](https://walkintubwithshower.com/plumbing-and-hot-water/): drain end, supply, shower valve, anti-scald protection, electrical for jets, floor and permits.
- [Safety, standing and seated](https://walkintubwithshower.com/walk-in-tub-shower-safety/): CDC bathroom injury data, NIA fall-prevention advice, CPSC scald times, and checklists for the standing showerer and the seated soaker.
- [Walk-in tub with shower vs walk-in shower, conversion or roll-in shower](https://walkintubwithshower.com/combo-vs-walk-in-shower-vs-conversion/): side-by-side comparison table.

## Main page
- [Walk-in tub with shower home](https://walkintubwithshower.com/): what a combo is, published spec numbers, how two bathing styles share one tub, FAQ, and a free written quote request.
